usage: 炸魚蛋 (zaa3 jyu4 daan2) is a noun referring to a popular fried dim sum food made of fish paste shaped into balls and deep-fried.
You can use 炸魚蛋 as the object of a sentence, for Example:  我想食炸魚蛋 (I want to eat fried fish balls).
When ordering food, 炸魚蛋 can appear with quantifiers, such as 一串炸魚蛋 (a skewer of fried fish balls).
炸魚蛋 is often used in casual conversation about snacks or street food.
You can also use 炸魚蛋 in descriptive sentences, like 呢間店嘅炸魚蛋好好味 (This shop’s fried fish balls taste very good).
